scope: Hardening selected after the primitive audit: typed evidence kind/payload correlation and adapter-independent immutable capture, exact-state, applicability, paging, reopen and mixed native/evidence rollback contracts. No new primitive, generalized assessment engine, wire/storage migration or application-model implementation.

changes.typedBoundary: EvidenceByKind is the single kind-to-payload map. EvidenceAppend uses a discriminated tuple union so wrong payloads and unrelated union arguments fail compilation. getEvidence/evidence/latestEvidence and service list infer the selected payload. Literal-kind application casts and export array casts are removed. The HTTP contract re-exports the same map, retaining its import path without a duplicate declaration.
changes.portableProof: repositoryContract automatically registers the five portable capture checks alongside thirteen base checks. A factory provides a fresh persisted project, same-project reopen and cleanup. SQLite registration now uses a disposable file rather than an in-memory project. Capture tests contain no SQL/driver/filesystem assumptions and use a deterministic observer.
changes.runtimeCompatibility: Existing append call shape, routes, payloads, physical storage and outcome/review semantics remain unchanged. Trusted storage JSON deserialization remains at the adapter boundary; compile-time types do not validate untrusted runtime payloads.
changes.testFixtures: Next-work capacity fault injection retains kind-specific result types and still creates the intended overflow. Fake observer hashes use valid SHA-256 syntax; captured native inputs remain explicit.

finalPortableFollowUp.reason: Removed an unnecessary gapless evidence-sequence assumption: require exact per-kind committed deltas, unchanged rollback export and a monotonic committed watermark. Also strengthen wrong-kind lookup isolation and complete baseline entity/link scope assertions. No runtime source behavior changed after full-run unit phase.

newSharedChecks.scope: All four kinds; duplicate payload replacement rejection, deep read/return alias protection, subject isolation and identical reopen export.

newSharedChecks.scope: Own writes readable in transaction; four capture kinds and command result rollback with a native creation; dependency index cleanup and ID reuse; one native commit, exact capture deltas and reopen retention.

newSharedChecks.name: exact entity/link/resource captures and native selections survive edits, deletion, schema changes and reopen
newSharedChecks.scope: Original criteria, qualified reference, resource observation and governing schema retained after current edits/deletion; configuration and complete baseline remain exact.

newSharedChecks.scope: Unselected annotations/equivalent observations preserve applicability, selected changes retire it, stale/unknown acceptance rolls back, accepted drift persists, review/outcome survive reopen.

newSharedChecks.name: evidence pages apply kind/subject before limits and latest means append order
newSharedChecks.scope: Interleaved subjects, selected continuation, backdated final append, invocation-time payload ownership and no native revision allocation.

verificationHistory: Typed generic reads exposed an uncorrelated next-work overflow mock; changed it to transform only the requested receipt page rather than claim every evidence kind returns receipts.

Initial synthetic observer hash and selected configuration fixture were corrected to satisfy real observation and endpoint/member guards; optional schema read is asserted before use. No product guard was weakened.

The full run reached the dead-code gate after 489 unit/196 browser/workbench checks and identified an existing HTTP map with the same name. Replaced the HTTP declaration with a re-export from core; no suppression or duplicated authority remains. Final type/API checks and complete quality gates passed.
Final portable assertion permits gaps in evidence sequence allocation; exact committed contents and rollback/reopen equality remain required.
limits: Only SQLite has executed this portable registration; no PostgreSQL or authenticated-team parity claim.
Physical SQL trigger and index-plan assertions remain separate adapter-specific evidence.
Generic compile-time kind correlation does not replace runtime request/service validation.
Reopen checks verify the provider fixture reopening the same persisted project; not power-loss/crash durability or distributed consensus.
No existing historical report/payload or product requirement status is rewritten.
The application-model goal remains active; this is primitive/contract hardening before that layer.
